touches.text: RECOVERY DEVICE (cairn/devices/recovery/; Recovery And Installation Manager: the host, install, upgrades, root, Rescue and trouble tickets)

Install and upgrades live here: the installer machine walks the host-seam intentions, verifies each, offers what's missing, applies, re-verifies. If xyz library needs an update, this is the component that does it. Any change to what the host is goes through here (6.6.3.1.1).
It outputs only its findings. It certifies nothing, records no crossing, and posts nothing; the gate consumes its findings.
gate: the == compare, in one place. A gate opens when every expected equals its actual. No oracle, ever.

WHY: the inspector does all the checks, so there is no need for more checks anywhere else. The inspector's output is consumed by the gate. The gate's output is the certificate. "This was how I meant it all along."

conflicts.ticket_says: install() skips verification for platform-excluded seams without running their verify step
conflicts.why: The outline states the installer 'verifies each' host-seam intention in its process flow, but the ticket changes it to skip the verify step for seams whose declared platforms exclude sys.platform. Both 'verifies each seam' and 'skips verification for some seams' cannot stand together.
